verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §2/§4.1 buildings and equipment list
verdicts.reason: Establishment has the buildings, equipment, facilities and services required for grain export.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §4.2 lux values, shatterproof-sleeved fittings

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §5.1: porous rough-sawn pine, unsealed crazed concrete, no coved skirting
verdicts.reason: Construction cannot be effectively cleaned; porous surfaces and cracks retain residue.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §5.3 bunded waste pad, grease trap, wet scrubber

verdicts.evidence: Track 5 §7 DAFF inspection room, stainless bench, sample fridge; Track 4 IB room

verdicts.evidence: Track 2 CCP-4 scalper 6mm screen + magnet; Track 6 cleaner/aspirator
verdicts.reason: Screening controls manage the risk of large contaminants.

verdicts.evidence: Track 2 CCP-4 scalper/magnet removes foreign matter
verdicts.reason: Large contaminants are removed via scalping and magnetic separation.

verdicts.evidence: Track 6 full Hygiene & Sanitation Plan with master cleaning schedule
verdicts.reason: A documented system of controls to manage hygiene exists.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §6 Waste Management SOP; Track 2 §6 waste procedure
verdicts.reason: System of controls for waste control and disposal is documented.

verdicts.evidence: Track 6 detailed SOPs/verification; Track 4 §6 waste streams
verdicts.reason: Hygiene and waste controls are effective for the operations conducted.

verdicts.evidence: Track 7 bait station map (9 stations); Track 3 bait register & activity log
verdicts.reason: A pest control system with rodent bait stations is in place.

verdicts.evidence: Track 7 §1: 'repeated rodent activity in receival zones with delayed escalation follow-up'
verdicts.reason: Repeated rodent activity with delayed escalation shows the pest system is not effective.

verdicts.evidence: Track 6 §8.1 retains records 'six months after the end of the relevant activity'
verdicts.reason: Hygiene records retained only six months, below the 2-year requirement.

verdicts.evidence: Track 3 cover: 'Records kept in Vietnamese for early entries; dates missing'; log rows in Vietnamese with blank dates
verdicts.reason: Records are not in English and lack dates on several rows.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §7.1 floors/equipment/drains clean; Track 6 §11 all areas maintained
verdicts.reason: Dedicated condition records show areas clean and hygienic despite minor debris note in Track 7.

verdicts.evidence: Track 3 Establishment Condition all 'None detected'; Track 4 §7.2 acceptable range
verdicts.reason: Condition inspections show no active infestation of goods.

verdicts.evidence: Track 7 BS-05 'Cracked lid', still listed Active
verdicts.reason: A bait station with a cracked lid is not fit for purpose/in good working order.

verdicts.evidence: Track 3 Chemical Storage Register: locked cage, separate room, 'stored off grain'
verdicts.reason: Chemicals stored segregated and off-grain so they do not contaminate the products.

verdicts.reason: Pesticide decanting bench sited next to the packing/preparation area risks contaminating that area.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 Dispatch/Transfer Dockets with destination premises and dest RE No.

verdicts.evidence: Track 8 §1 security zoning, sealed storage, pre-load inspections
verdicts.reason: Controls to minimise contamination/infestation risk are documented.

verdicts.evidence: Track 8 §3: 'Substitution controls rely on single-operator checks for selected late-shift dispatches'

verdicts.evidence: Track 8 §4 packaging/containment addressed (QC records to shift summary)

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 Archive Register: Rejected/failed goods 'Rejected-goods archive verified'
verdicts.reason: Rejected/failed goods records are retained and verified.

verdicts.reason: Traceability records are in English and dated, with only a minor legibility annotation that was countersigned.
